title: Giris yapma
purpose: Implements FR-E1-03: Email/phone + password login with safe error messages, 5-attempt lockout, subscription sync on success, and social login options.

loading.description: Logo, two skeleton input fields, and a disabled Giris Yap button are shown.

ready.description: Email/phone input, password field with visibility toggle, Remember Me checkbox, Forgot Password link, social login buttons, and register/guest links.

empty.description: Message explaining session could not be initialised, with a Retry button.

error.description: Safe inline error (no account enumeration). After 5 failures, remaining attempts shown; at 0, navigate to lockout.

offline.description: Form inputs disabled, offline banner visible. Biometric login remains available if previously enabled.
